notes: German-language ROM variant (bk2k_lg3) of the Williams System 11B coil diagnostic: the ROM titles the Solenoid Test SPULEN TEST (test 05) instead of COIL TEST; every other step of the walk is the same. Manual-Down + Advance enters the tests, Auto-Up + Advance walks Music, Display, Sound, All Lamps, Single Lamps to the coil test, which then cycles A-side, C-side, controlled and special circuits by itself. Keyboard handling stays off; the driver has no simulator and no mechanics.

actions.label: observe complete A/C, controlled and special coil cycle
